name: raw-capture
description: Turn raw captured writing into clean, structured output: pasted dictation transcripts or photographed handwritten pages in, manuscript prose (clean-draft), sorted story-development structure (sort-brainstorm), or a filled Five Commandments skeleton with crisis matrix (fill-commandments) out. Ported from the Zo dictation family with the transcription layer removed — the interpretive layer travels, the pipeline doesn't. Faithfulness rules are shared across all three via clean-draft/references.
